summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Teck Resources Limited, a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting its second quarter 2026 earnings release schedule. It announces that Q2 2026 results will be published on July 23, 2026, with a webcast and conference call for investors. No transaction, special event, or strategic action is disclosed. This is a routine periodic report of earnings timing, not a special situation under any defined category. The filing does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or any other special-situations event.
